name: Stealth Homepage — production design contract
northStar: Il visitatore deve pensare: il mio lavoro potrebbe essere più semplice; questi capiscono davvero le rotture quotidiane e sanno costruire la soluzione.
narrative: Il tuo lavoro dovrebbe essere più semplice.
Il lavoro quotidiano si riempie di attriti piccoli ma cumulativi.
Quattro casi concreti rendono il problema riconoscibile.
Stealth entra solo dopo: prima ci sediamo accanto a te.
Poi lo costruiamo, usando gli stessi elementi del lavoro già mostrati.
Il sistema resta capace di evolvere.
CTA finale quieta: raccontaci come lavori.

rules: White dominant, Stealth blue is the only accent.
No gradients, green, SaaS card grids, generic AI symbols, stock people or fake dashboard hero.
Objects must look like recognizable work artifacts: document, spreadsheet, email, paper, phone, signature, attachment, software fragment.
Sections are full width. Borders/shadows belong to work objects only.
Editorial asymmetry, large negative space, controlled depth and overlap.

motion.principle: La pagina fa ciò che racconta: accumula complessità, la rende evidente, poi la seleziona e la semplifica.

sequence: Start with a plausible, mostly ordered desk of work artifacts.
Introduce a duplicate Word document, extra paper, attachment, phone photo and notification.
Increase density without turning the page into random chaos.
Crossfade headline from positive statement to lost-time question.
Everything reverses exactly when scrolling upward.

casesDesktop.mode: vertical scroll drives horizontal pinned track
requirements: No carousel UI, arrows or required swipe.
Active scene is centered, sharp and full opacity.
Previous/next remain partially visible, smaller, dimmer and slightly blurred.
Maximum three important visual objects at once.

sequence: Headline enters after visual selection starts.

motion.build: The same work artifacts converge into one concrete practice/work surface; Word/PDF becomes output, Excel stops being the center, phone and software coordinate.
motion.evolution: A new requirement enters and is absorbed without recreating a parallel Excel/mail process.
motion.reducedMotion: No scrub or horizontal pin. All final states remain readable and complete.

qualityGates: The horizontal chapter must not look or behave like a marketing carousel.
Returning upward must restore every previous state without glitches.
Stealth must not appear before the four concrete cases.
The blue section must feel like a narrative turning point, not decoration.
AI is one case among four, never the visual identity of the site.
No large section cards or box-within-box layouts.
At 320–430px: no horizontal overflow, clipped text or desktop pinning.
With JavaScript disabled the complete narrative remains readable.
Core Web Vitals are protected by using HTML/CSS/SVG work objects rather than heavy video or image sequences.
